estimand.rres: log2(RRES) = task FE + configuration FE; sum(configuration FE)=0; report 2^beta
estimand.copy: copied_fraction = task FE + configuration FE; sum(configuration FE)=0; report 100*beta pp
estimand.interval: pointwise 95% cluster-bootstrap percentile CI; not simultaneous
estimand.scope: Successful artifacts only; no extrapolation to failed configurations on a task
estimand.bootstrap_variation: Across sampled task/repository clusters, not repeated agent runs
